The topology_boundary_auditor shows a high mask confidence (0.8921), but this only indicates the segmentation model found a coherent region for the cart, not that the human figures are artifact-free. The Router's severity ratings seem appropriate, though the structural collapse in the driver's arm might be even more severe given the pose auditor's findings. I will maintain the Router's severity ratings but note the strong expert confirmation.
